theorems.name: Submission.cmr_tdn_null_set_cutoffs
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid n)), IsCompact K → volume K = 0 → ∃ a : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (a k)) ∧ (∀ k, HasCompactSupport (a k)) ∧ (∀ k y, 0 ≤ a k y) ∧ (∀ k y, a k y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ y ∈ K, a k y = 1) ∧ (∀ y, y ∉ K → ∀ᶠ k in atTop, a k y = 0) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫ y, a k y) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
